data.spiritual_significance: Rosanna is a name rich in symbolism and spiritual significance. In Christian traditions, roses are often used as symbols of the Passion of Christ, as they bloom in the Easter season. The name also signifies the spiritual journey towards inner beauty, growth, and transformation, as the rose blooms from a bud into a beautiful flower.
